name: Light Chicken and Chickpea Curry
method: Cook the rice following the packet instructions and keep warm. Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the sliced onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the diced chicken and cook for 5 minutes, turning, until sealed and lightly golden on all sides.
Stir in the tikka paste for 1 minute, then add the drained chickpeas and passata. Simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through with no pink inside.
Stir in the spinach for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted, season to taste, then spoon over the rice and serve.
